messages:
elaine: Heads-up 1 quickstart refresh PR to tighten up local dev flow + Docker auth notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4722 Please eyeball the Node + Python snippets and the Dockerfile (we now recommend `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY` for prod and `.env.dev`/rdw login alt for local).

kevin: On it. One consistency ask: all SDK examples should show the env-var pattern first, then the `rdw login --dev` fallback. Also verify that the Python snippet uses `Redwood(api_key=...)` not `Client(...)`.

rahul: I noticed the Dockerfile example sets `ARG NODE_ENV=production` then later runs `npm run dev` in the compose override. That will confuse people. Suggest adding comment: "use ARG for build-time, use ENV for runtime vars" and show a `docker-compose.override.yml` that runs dev.

elaine: Good catch. Updated the Dockerfile and added this compose override example:```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        - NODE_ENV=development
    env_file: .env.dev
    volumes:
      - .:/usr/src/app:delegated
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    command: npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
```

kevin: Tiny wording nit: call out that `--host 0.0.0.0` is required so the container binds externally. Also add a one-liner for macOS Docker users about file sharing slowness and `:delegated`.

docs-bot: link-checker: scanned PR 4722 2 links OK, 1 image missing alt text.

elaine: Fixed image alt and pushed. I also added a short migration note for v3->v4 SDK users: "v3: `Client(token=...)` -> v4: `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` (JS)" and equivalent Python example.

rahul: Can we add a troubleshooting bullet under "Auth in Docker"? Proposed bullets: ensure `.env.dev` is present and listed in `env_file`, check container logs for `Missing API key`, and confirm you didn't bake the key into the image via `ENV` at build time.

kevin: LGTM. I'll leave an approve. :+1:

elaine: Thanks! Also added a short code snippet for `rdw login --dev` flow:```bash
# quick dev login (creates .rdw-token locally)
rdw login --dev
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat ~/.rdw-token)
```

ci-bot: preview-build: docs-staging/pr-4722 10 minutes to preview.

elaine: I merged after approvals and the preview looks good. Tagging #eng-dev in case anyone wants to sync on SDK naming changes. Closing thread.

kevin: Nice cleanup. One follow-up: can we add a short note in the quickstart checklist that recommends rotating API keys used in local dev if they were checked into a repo?"
